summary: A good daily: Brazil and Colombia are gimmes, Vietnam at #2, Uganda and India surprise, and the famous coffee names (Kenya, Costa Rica, Jamaica) are the traps.
reasons: Casual found 7 (Brazil, Colombia, Ethiopia, Vietnam, Guatemala, Indonesia, Peru) and spent all 5 lives on Kenya (#22), Costa Rica (#17), Jamaica, Mexico (#12) and El Salvador (#24): famous origins cost lives, but each ranked one shows its figure, so the misses teach.

Leaving out the Central African Republic is right: FAO's 316,108 t is about 100 times StoneX's 2023 estimate (about 46,000 bags, 37th) and its 2023 coffee exports were worth about $18k. Kept, #10 would be an answer no one can name and the reveal would teach something false. Naming it is free.
Coffee words (arabica, java, sumatra, kona, mocha, starbucks) are free and spellings like columbia, vietman, guatamala work. A casual Blitz stalls at about a dozen, so it is a list, not a Blitz.
fixes: Matcher (src/game, every countries list): "south america" offers "did you mean South Africa?". Continent words are natural guesses on this list ("South American coffee") and should be free with no offer.
